# NPM Improved v1.2.1

NPM Improved v1.2.1 fixes the first production updater rough edges and redesigns **Settings → Update** so the primary action is obvious and close at hand.

## Better Update workspace

The main **Update to vX.Y.Z** button now lives in the top software-update card beside the installed/latest version information.

Administrators no longer have to scroll to the bottom of the page and enter a password before deciding what they want to do.

Update, Restart, and Rollback now work like this:

1. choose the action;
2. confirm with the current administrator password;
3. NPM Improved performs the lifecycle operation;
4. the page shows progress and reconnects automatically.

Normal updating is visually separated from Maintenance & Recovery controls.

## Better progress and failure reporting

The Update page now shows:

- installed → target version;
- current lifecycle state;
- progress through preflight, download, staging, restart, and verification;
- start/completion timestamps;
- pulled image digest when available;
- the most recent failure directly beneath the update card.

A failed update remains visible for the current session so the administrator can read it. Reloading the Update page acknowledges and clears the stale failed status; the failure itself remains recorded in the audit log.

## Useful Docker pull errors

The temporary update handoff now captures Docker's real pull output.

Instead of only reporting a generic “Docker could not pull” message, NPM Improved distinguishes cases such as:

- registry authorization or package-visibility denial;
- missing release manifests;
- unsupported host architecture;
- other Docker/registry failures.

## Dual update distribution

Stable releases now publish through two independent update channels:

1. the normal multi-architecture GHCR image; and
2. architecture-specific, SHA-256-verified Docker image bundles attached to the public GitHub Release.

The UI updater tries GHCR first. If the registry rejects an anonymous pull or is otherwise unavailable, NPM Improved automatically downloads the matching public GitHub Release bundle, verifies its checksum, loads it into Docker, and continues the same health-checked replacement process.

The release workflow tests anonymous GHCR access and records a warning when it is unavailable, but the stable release can still ship because the independently verified GitHub Release bundle provides the update path.

## Updating

v1.2.1 is the bridge to the dual-channel updater. Installations already running v1.2.1 or newer can use **Settings → Update** even if anonymous GHCR access is unavailable.

Published channels include:

```text
ghcr.io/gigabytegrove/npm-improved:v1.2.1
ghcr.io/gigabytegrove/npm-improved:1.2.1
ghcr.io/gigabytegrove/npm-improved:latest

npm-improved-v1.2.1-linux-amd64.tar.gz
npm-improved-v1.2.1-linux-arm64.tar.gz
npm-improved-v1.2.1-SHA256SUMS.txt
```
